title: Judge reply (one call per batch)
description: What the judge model must answer for a batch of claims. The shape is checked here; that every id of the batch is present once, that every judged tag of the group is present once per item and that the names belong to the group is checked in code, against the batch.

id.description: The id given in the claim block.

p.description: How sure the judge is that the tag applies.

rule_ref.description: The rule the decision rests on, for example 'Context-dependent rule 3', or null.
